predicates.label: Event
predicates.description: The social event this task, budget line, vendor, sponsor, guest, table or program item belongs to

predicates.label: Kind
predicates.description: boda, xv, bautizo, aniversario or other, as the owner says it

predicates.label: Date
predicates.description: The day of the event, at noon local time

predicates.label: Planning started
predicates.description: Day the event was created here, at noon local time: tasks due before it were late from the start

predicates.label: Template
predicates.description: Key of the template the event started from, or none

predicates.label: Hosts
predicates.description: Who the event is for (the couple, the quinceañera...), in the owner's words

predicates.label: Capacity
predicates.description: Places the venue or the plan allows

predicates.label: Total budget
predicates.description: What the hosts plan to spend, in cents

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: planning, done or cancelled

predicates.label: When
predicates.description: Relative to the event day: -12m, -2w, -3d, 0d, +1w (months, weeks, days)

predicates.label: Fixed date
predicates.description: A fixed due day, at noon, instead of an offset

predicates.label: Area
predicates.description: The budget area the task is about, or general

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: pending, done or dropped (a dropped task stays in the file)

predicates.label: Done on
predicates.description: Day the task was done, at noon local time

predicates.label: Note
predicates.description: A short note in the owner's words

predicates.label: Order
predicates.description: Order of the task in its event

predicates.label: Origin
predicates.description: template or owner

predicates.label: Area
predicates.description: Slug of the budget area

predicates.label: Planned
predicates.description: What the hosts plan to spend in this area, in cents

predicates.label: Suggested share
predicates.description: The template's suggested share of the total budget

predicates.label: Order
predicates.description: Order of the area

predicates.label: Area
predicates.description: Budget area of the vendor

predicates.label: Contract total
predicates.description: Agreed price, in cents

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: quoting, hired or discarded

predicates.label: Pay off by
predicates.description: Day the balance must be paid, at noon

predicates.label: Contact
predicates.description: How to reach the vendor, as the owner gave it

predicates.label: Note
predicates.description: What is included, conditions, in the owner's words

predicates.label: Amount
predicates.description: Amount paid, in cents

predicates.label: Area
predicates.description: Budget area of the payment

predicates.label: Paid by
predicates.description: Who paid (the couple, the bride's parents, a sponsor...), in the owner's words

predicates.label: Note
predicates.description: Deposit, settlement..., in the owner's words

predicates.label: Vendor
predicates.description: The vendor a payment went to

predicates.label: Event
predicates.description: The event a payment is for

predicates.label: Role
predicates.description: What they sponsor: lazo, arras, pastel, velación...

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: to_ask, accepted, declined or removed

predicates.label: Covers
predicates.description: What they give or pay for, in the owner's words

predicates.label: Amount covered
predicates.description: What they pay for, in cents, when it is money

predicates.label: Area
predicates.description: Budget area their help covers

predicates.label: Group
predicates.description: Bride's family, friends of the groom..., as the owner names it

predicates.label: Seats invited
predicates.description: Places in the invitation (pases)

predicates.label: RSVP
predicates.description: pending, yes or no

predicates.label: Coming
predicates.description: Places confirmed, at most the seats invited

predicates.label: Diet
predicates.description: Food restrictions, in the owner's words

predicates.label: Note
predicates.description: A short note

predicates.label: Table
predicates.description: The table the invitation is seated at

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: active or removed (a removed guest stays in the file)

predicates.label: Seats
predicates.description: Places at the table

predicates.label: Order
predicates.description: Order of the table in lists

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: active or removed

predicates.label: Time
predicates.description: HH:MM; 00:00 to 05:59 counts as after midnight

predicates.label: Vendor
predicates.description: The vendor in charge, if any

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: active or removed

predicates.label: Kind
predicates.description: The kind of event the template is for

predicates.label: Content
predicates.description: The template's areas (with suggested shares) and tasks (with offsets), as JSON

predicates.description: seed (comes with the howware and is updated with it) or owner (made by the owner; never overwritten)

predicates.label: State
predicates.description: active or retired
